purpose: Exact additive native Keyring, capability, validator identity binding and frozen Config46 schema integration. Original production baseline hashes remain authoritative; historical verifier and constructor bytes are retained.

crypto/smartcont/config-code.fc.text: cell vauth_apply_update(cell update, cell evidence) impure asm "VAUTH_APPLY";

;; The configuration master key is a generic writer too, and on an active
    ;; chain a validator set is not a parameter it may write. Thrown rather
    ;; than declined: this message is signed by a key that is meant to know
    ;; what it is doing, and silently discarding its instruction would report
    ;; success for a change that did not happen.
    throw_if(48, validator_auth_active() & validator_set_param(param_index));

crypto/smartcont/elector-code.fc.text:
if (named_identity) {
    members~udict_set_builder(256, validator_pubkey, begin_cell()
      .store_tomis(msg_value)
      .store_uint(now(), 32)
      .store_uint(max_factor, 32)
      .store_uint(src_addr, 256)
      .store_uint(adnl_addr, 256)
      ;; in a reference, because the record plus another 256 bits no longer
      ;; fits a dictionary leaf beside its key
      .store_ref(begin_cell().store_uint(named_identity, 256).end_cell()));
  }
